luca: Heads up — noticed a ~12% drop in prefix cache hit-rate on prod after last night's kernel + attention-optimizer flip. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/prefix-hit?range=6h :eyes:

amanda: ugh. which deploy id?

luca: deploy id d-2026-03-attnopt. Hits go from ~78% -> ~66% for the 0-16 token lead window, latency up ~8ms p50.

raj: any correlation with quant profile change? I thought we applied quant profile B only to larger models yesterday.

luca: we did A->B for the attn microkernel path on xform-small-medium variants. Quant changes limited, but the kernel swap triggers a different key normalization path. I think keying canonicalization got relaxed.

sarah: can you paste the profiler snippet? maybe KV lookup logs?

luca: paste: ```
[perf] prefix_lookup(key=0x7f3a2b, norm=v2) -> miss
[perf] kv_hash=0x9f1234 -> bucket 12
[perf] canonicalize: tokenizer.normalize_case=true, strip_spaces=false
[perf] kernel_route=attn_opt_v2, quant_profile=B
```

mike: interesting — kernel attn_opt_v2 writes salt bytes at key formation time for alignment, I flagged that as an optimization but maybe it changed ordering of tokens when combined with the new tokenizer normalization.

raj: do we have a simple reproduction? a short prompt where seed -> different key across kernels?

luca: yes, repro snippet below: ```
prompt = "User: Hello\nAssistant: "
run with kernel=attn_opt_v1 -> key = 0xabc123
run with kernel=attn_opt_v2 -> key = 0x9f1c88
```

amanda: if keys differ, warmup won't hit. two mitigation paths: 1) normalize key pipeline to deterministic canonical form before kernel-specific salting, or 2) add a compatibility salt mapping during lookup. Which is lower-risk?

mike: canonical normalization preferred long-term. Short-term we can add a compatibility shim in runtime: when miss, consult a slow fallback that removes kernel-salt and re-lookup. cost = extra latency on miss only.

infra-bot: deploy d-2026-03-attnopt rolled at 02:13 UTC by @mike. No rollback requested.

sarah: can we quantify how many misses are stable mismatches (same prompt, different key) vs true cold prompts? need overlap set.

luca: ran a diff on 1h sample: 24k total prefix lookups; 2.9k additional misses vs baseline. Of those, ~2.1k are stable mismatches (same input, different canonical key across kernel variants). So majority are keying mismatches.

raj: ok that's actionable. Proposed plan: 1) hotfix shim (compat lookup) -> ship quick patch to reduce miss spike, 2) follow-up: canonicalization refactor and tests, 3) add unit tests that assert key invariants across kernels/quant profiles.

amanda: agree. who's owner for the hotfix? mike?

mike: I can do hotfix, will add toggle gflag runtime.kv_compat_lookup=true default=false and enable for prod while we validate. Plan to push in next maintenance window (30m).

luca: I'll prepare the mapping of affected prompts and example keys for the fallback logic. also adding a small feature-flagged metric: kv.compat_lookup_hits.

sarah: also open question: do batching heuristics exacerbate the issue? with different kernel routing, requests may get rebalanced causing many first-token misses at the same time. observed small spike in concurrent misses.

raj: add a guard in batcher: when routing across kernel families, prefer sticky affinity for a short warmup window to avoid cross-routing thrash. Low-risk config change.

mike: noted. I'll do hotfix + gflag and a rollback plan. If hotfix reduces the extra 2.9k misses -> verify with prefresh dashboard in 15m after deploy.

luca: quick command I ran for traces: `rbxctl trace --service=runtime --filter=prefix_lookup --since=1h | jq '. | select(.kernel=="attn_opt_v2")'`

amanda: thanks. after hotfix we should also run synthetic warmups across both kernels to ensure stable key mapping. I'm scheduling a canary job.

mike: pushed patch to staging, enabling kv_compat_lookup. Patch id: PR#4682. Rolling to prod in 10m.

infra-bot: starting canary deploy d-2026-03-attnopt-hotfix -> 10% nodes.

luca: post-deploy numbers (canary): baseline hit 78% -> regional hit 76.5% (down to 1.2% gap). kv.compat_lookup_hits = 1.9k during canary interval.

amanda: good reduction. proceed stage rollout, monitor memory/latency impact.

mike: rolling to 100% now. will watch metrics and post final numbers.

luca: final after 30m: global hit 77.9% (almost back to baseline). Additional p50 latency back within 1ms. We'll still follow-up with canonicalization refactor and unit tests.

raj: add retro notes + timeline in eng-runtime wiki and tag release.

sarah: nice quick recovery, great troubleshooting. :rocket:

mike: filing follow-up tasks: RT-1123 (canonicalize key pipeline), RT-1124 (batcher affinity heuristics), RT-1125 (add key invariants to CI).

luca: thanks all. closing thread after we merge RT-1123.
